items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I think Rube Wolfe was there, but I really idolized him [Tatum]; he used to go to a lot of track meets with Tatum.

ctx.x: Well, I lived in Oklahoma for a few years when I was a child.

Well, we played Oklahoma. And they had -- you know, you'd be at this carnival and they had flat cars where they carry the tents and the things on this, and they had all kinds of shows, they had the minstrel shows, which was really a big attraction, and they had side-shows like with the freaks in the circus, and they had -- what did they call those things? I forget the name of these stands they had where you spin the wheel, and you know, and they had the Ferris Wheel and the Merry Go Round -- well, all this was…
that town had started something; these guys had started something and the guys at the carnival would come out and swing with at everything, you know.
